title: 3rd Day
categoryChain: Everyday short duas in the month of Ramadhan

verses.translation: O Allah, on this day, (please) confer upon me with sound mentality and acumen,
take me away from foolishness and deception,

verses.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ لِىْ نَصِيْبًا مِنْ كُلِّ خَيْرِ تُنْزِلُ فِيْهِ،
verses.translation: and decide for me a share from each goodness that You descend on this day,
in the name of Your magnanimity, O most Magnanimous of all those who are magnanimous!
